_note: Contract specs for risk sizing. `usd_per_point` is what ONE contract gains or loses when the quoted price moves by 1.00, so risk = |entry - stop| * usd_per_point for every instrument, FX included. `journal` is the instrument name used in the trading-coach journal. A symbol that is absent, or present with verified:false, is never used for risk maths — the engine reports 'no contract spec' instead of guessing, because a wrong dollar figure is worse than no figure when the per-trade cap decides whether a setup is takeable.
